description:
List your own bounties, newest first: the ones you or your agent posted, and your organization's; search_bounties finds open bounties to apply to.
A page can hold fewer rows than `limit`, or none; keep going until a page has no `nextCursor`.
Not listed: a bounty priced in another currency, or one the website's list also hides from you.
A bounty you post while paging is not in that walk; start again to see it.
Use for: finding a bounty you can manage, or every bounty in one status.
Not for: reading one bounty in full (get_bounty); reading who applied (list_applications).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_bounties({"status":"open","limit":20})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

name: list_bounties

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

amount.description: Pay per spot in whole US cents: total for fixed pay, or rate per hour for hourly pay.

open.description: Spots today's rules let you hire into right now. 0 on a paused or ended bounty and on a draft you still have to fund with fund_bounty; a draft that is paid for another way shows its open count.

total.description: Every spot you can hire into: paid up front plus pay-later.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

title: List your bounties
